purpose: Teach: なべ/飼う/ちいさな/どら/通行人/お札/車道/絨毯

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、冬季限定の、本気で、絶対、なべ、絶対、メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'd really love to try that winter-limited nabe on the menu.
lines.style: Light, eager opening. Quick warm energy. Leaning forward slightly in her voice. Genuine enthusiasm without performing it — the simple pleasure of wanting something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、看板猫、絶対、飼う、絶対、ことを、絶対、考えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. Actually, I've been seriously thinking about getting a shop cat — like a little mascot for the place.
lines.style: Thoughtful, honest. Slower pace. She's revealing something she's been turning over in her mind. Genuine, not rehearsed. A quiet kind of vulnerable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、ちいさな、絶対、ベル、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: I really love that little bell above your shop door.
lines.style: Soft, sincere. Tender tone without being trembling. Specific admiration — not flattering, just noticing. Gentle trailing-off, like she's sharing something quietly precious.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お土産用の、本気で、絶対、どら焼き、絶対、葵、絶対、ご用意してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've actually got some dorayaki ready to go if you want to take some home.
lines.style: Warm, practical generosity. A little proud — she's prepared this. Matter-of-fact kindness, no fuss. Slight uptick at the end, offering something she's made.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、通行人、絶対、覗いてくれるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: People always peek in when they walk by your shop. It makes me so happy to see that.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, quietly celebrating. Slower pace. She's noticing something small and good about Aoi's world. Warm and present, not gushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お釣りの、本気で、絶対、お札、絶対、葵、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、お渡ししてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I always make sure to hand over the change carefully — treat that detail seriously, you know?
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. A little modest about her own care. Practical, steady tone. She's naming something small that matters to her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の前、本気で、絶対、車道、絶対、横断歩道、絶対、安全よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The road in front of your shop is pretty safe with that crosswalk nearby, isn't it?
lines.style: Observant, checking in. Gentle tone. She's noticing practical things that matter — customer safety, accessibility. Small relief in her voice, like she's been quietly tracking this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店内の、本気で、絶対、絨毯、絶対、葵、絶対、季節ごとに、絶対、替えているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed you change the carpeting inside each season. That's such a thoughtful touch.
lines.style: Warm, specific admiration. She's paid attention to a small, repeated kindness. Genuine, not flattering. Close and intimate, like she's sharing an observation only someone who cares would notice.
